description: A volatility (ATR) stop: entry minus (long) or plus (short) a multiple of the average true range. Give atr, or at least five recent daily ranges (high minus low). Computed with the same function as Clear Tape's free atr stop-loss calculator page (linked in the result), not estimated. Returns the inputs, each result with its unit, the formula and the page link. Educational, not investment advice.

atr.description: Average true range in USD (e.g. the 14-day ATR). Give this or ranges.

entry.description: Entry price per share in USD.

lang.description: Language of the returned text: "en" (default) or "zh" (Simplified Chinese).

multiple.description: ATR multiple for the stop distance, commonly 1.5 to 3.

ranges.description: Alternative to atr: 5 to 500 recent daily ranges (high minus low) in USD; their average stands in for the ATR.

name: calculate_atr_stop
title: ATR stop-loss calculator
